# Digital Hujra

> Digital Hujra is a digital studio in Batkhela, Malakand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We help local KP businesses establish and grow their digital presence through POS systems, e-commerce stores, custom software, product photography, WhatsApp Business, and Google Business services.

## What We Do

We offer six core services for small and medium businesses across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa:

- **POS Systems** — Inventory management, sales tracking, and barcode printing for retail and pharmacy businesses.
- **E-commerce Stores** — Complete online stores with product listings, Cash on Delivery, and WhatsApp checkout, tailored for KP markets.
- **Custom Software** — Bespoke web applications, CRMs, and automation tools built for local business workflows.
- **Product Photography** — Professional product photography and videography from our studio in Batkhela.
- **WhatsApp Business** — Profile setup, green tick verification, channel creation, catalog, and broadcast lists.
- **Google Business** — Profile creation, optimization, local SEO, photo uploads, and review management.

## Packages & Pricing

We do not publish a fixed price list. Each package page describes exactly what is included; the price for a specific project is agreed after a free consultation — in person or on WhatsApp — so it fits the local business's budget. Payment is typically split: an advance to start, and the balance once the client is fully satisfied.

- [View All Packages](https://www.digitalhujra.com/packages)
- [View Our Services](https://www.digitalhujra.com/services)

## Case Studies

- [Classyfitters](https://www.digitalhujra.com/work/classyfitters) — E-commerce store, product photography, WhatsApp Business, Google Business Profile for a clothing brand in Batkhela.
- [Al Ansar Abaya](https://www.digitalhujra.com/work/al-ansar-abaya) — Full digital presence including e-commerce, product shoot, WhatsApp verified badge, and Google Business for an abaya brand in Chakdara.
- [Raazina Essence](https://www.digitalhujra.com/work/raazina-essence) — 50+ professional perfume product images across two studio sessions for a fragrance brand in Swat.
- [Bayan Cafe](https://www.digitalhujra.com/work/bayan-cafe) — Complete visual identity including logo, color system, typography, brand guidelines, and print collateral.
- [Top Man Tailor](https://www.digitalhujra.com/work/order-studio-tailor) — Order Studio: a custom order-management and retail POS web app covering orders, customers, karigars, measurement templates, payments, inventory, and analytics.

## About

Founded in 2026 by a team of designers, developers, and photographers from Malakand Division. Digital Hujra focuses exclusively on small and medium businesses in KP who want to reach customers online for the first time.
